title: Tell us how today went
lead: Talk like you would to a friend. We pick out pain, bleeding, sleep, mood and medicines from what you say and show you before anything is saved.
startHint: Tap to start · up to one minute

examples.title: For example, say
examples.pain: “I had a really bad headache today”
examples.flash: “I had three hot flashes last night”

record.title: Listening
record.livePending: Your words appear here once you stop recording. When you’re done, tap stop.

review.title: Here’s what we understood
review.help: Tap an item to leave it out of this log; tap again to bring it back.
review.noteBody: If heavy bleeding with strong pain keeps going or makes you dizzy, tell a doctor.
review.confirm: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing selected} one {Confirm and save # item} other {Confirm and save # items}}

saved.title: {count, plural, one {# item saved} other {# items saved}}
saved.body: Everything is in today’s log and you can edit it any time.
saved.reminderBody: Send a reminder to log your day every night at 21:00?
saved.reminderError: Couldn’t save the reminder; try again.

empty.title: Nothing to log found
empty.body: Try again a little more clearly — say the symptom and how strong it is. Or log by hand.
empty.silentBody: Hold the microphone closer and try again.

privacy: Your voice is sent to an AI service only to turn it into text and is deleted after processing; Ritme doesn’t keep it.

error.deniedBody: To log by voice, allow microphone access for Ritme in your browser settings. Until then you can log by hand.
error.unsupportedTitle: Recording isn't possible in this browser
error.unsupportedBody: Your browser doesn't support audio recording or the page isn't secure. Update the browser or log by hand.
error.noMicBody: Connect a microphone or log by hand.
error.tooShort: That was too short — tap, say how you feel, then tap again.
error.uploadBody: Check your connection and try again.
